name: comp-288
title: Success With Undo Actions
description: Static success notification with green checkmark, single message line, two action buttons separated by a divider, and dismissible close.
use: You need to confirm an action with options to view the result or undo, without interrupting the user.
avoid: For stacked or auto-dismissing notifications; use a toast system for non-persistent alerts.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
